title: The most expensive watches ever sold at auction
hook: The Most Expensive Watches Ever Sold.
why: LISTICLE, 6-8 slides, one record per slide, highest first. Use only results confirmed on the auction house's own results page (Christie's, Phillips, Sotheby's, Antiquorum) or two trusted outlets; give hammer price with fees stated, sale year and auction house. Candidates to verify (drop any you cannot confirm): Patek Philippe Grandmaster Chime 6300A-010 (Only Watch 2019); Patek Philippe Henry Graves Supercomplication; Paul Newman's own Rolex Daytona 6239; Rolex 'Bao Dai'; Patek Philippe 1518 in steel. Photos only via photo.js (auction lot page with the reference, or free-licence Commons); a record without a usable photo gets an A-number slide instead. Caption lists each result with its source.
